verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe a 'durable execution' capability where agents 'preserve their progress across transient API failures and application errors or restarts' and support long-running, human-in-the-loop workflows — directly matching the checkpoint/resume story. Message-history APIs also support resuming a coherent run. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that resumption is exact-state-preserving after a real crash, and deeper documentation of the checkpointing mechanism itself.
